name: AI Parabellum

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tool — plans, eligibility check, FAQ

requirements: AI tools only; any type of AI tool accepted
AI tool directories themselves are explicitly not allowed
One-time payment, listing is permanent and Google-indexed; reviewed within 24 hours with full refund if not approved
preparation: AI tool URL (a free automated 'Check Your Tool Eligibility' pre-check is offered before paying)
Payment method — Basic $39 (was $99) or Featured $89 (was $199) one-time; Gumroad checkout available as an alternative
Tool details to supply at checkout
workflow: Optionally run the free 'Check Your Tool Eligibility' pre-check on your URL
Choose Basic ($39) or Featured ($89, 30 days site-wide + newsletter mention + verified badge)
Pay securely (or via the Gumroad link), providing the tool URL at checkout
Manual review within 24h; tool published as a dedicated article page, or full refund
watchFor: Edit requests after publication cost a $20 alteration fee — get details right the first time
Post-hoc upgrade to Verified/Featured is a separate $199 'promote' package at /promote-ai-tool/
Prices shown are 'limited-time' discounts off $99/$199 list prices
Do not submit if the product is another AI directory — explicitly banned
countsAsLive: A dedicated, Google-indexed article page for the tool exists on aiparabellum.com and appears in the New Tools / index sections
unknowns: How long featured-site-wide exposure persists beyond the stated 30 days
Whether the discounted $39/$89 prices are stable
